description: Rewrite Godot 3 GDScript and shaders to Godot 4 where that is mechanical: @export/@onready/@tool, renamed classes, functions, properties and constants, yield() to await, connect()/emit_signal() to signals, funcref() to callables, moved members (OS.get_ticks_msec() to Time), shader renames (hint_albedo to source_color, WORLD_MATRIX to MODEL_MATRIX, ...) and SCREEN_TEXTURE/DEPTH_TEXTURE to a hint uniform. Strings, comments and node paths are left alone. Without `write` it only reports; with `write: true` it rewrites the scripts. It lists what still needs a hand (setget, move_and_slide arguments, rpc keywords, unknown export hints). Scenes and project settings are not migrated (Godot's --convert-3to4 does those). `files` limits it to some scripts; `detail` brief shows up to 12 changes per file. Running it twice changes nothing more. Use it before fixing Godot 3 findings one by one, then run godot_review.

detail.description: brief (capped lists) or full (everything); default brief

files.description: only these res:// scripts or shaders

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

write.description: rewrite the scripts on disk (default false: report only)

name: godot_migrate
title: Port Godot 3 scripts to Godot 4
